name: kisakcod-browser-port
description: Browser platform work for the KisakCOD COD4 reimplementation

scripts.check:web:syntax: node --check web/asset_profile.mjs && node --check web/asset_store.mjs && node --check web/browser_capabilities.mjs && node --check web/capability_probe_worker.mjs && node --check web/diagnostic_mission_route.mjs && node --check web/engine_protocol.mjs && node --check web/engine_worker_host.mjs && node --check web/engine_worker.mjs && node --check web/input_controller_core.mjs && node --check web/launcher.mjs && node --check web/product_checkpoint_controller.mjs && node --check web/product_engine_worker_host.mjs && node --check web/product_engine_worker.mjs && node --check web/product_launcher.mjs && node --check web/product_mount_controller.mjs && node --check web/product_protocol.mjs && node --check web/web_audio_driver.mjs && node --check web/worker_sync_filesystem.mjs
scripts.check:web:types: npm run check:web:types:strict && npm run check:web:types:runtime
scripts.check:web:types:strict: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --lib ES2024,DOM,DOM.Iterable web/asset_profile.mjs web/input_controller_core.mjs web/product_checkpoint_controller.mjs web/product_protocol.mjs
scripts.check:web:types:runtime: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --strict false --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --lib ES2024,DOM,DOM.Iterable web/asset_store.mjs web/worker_sync_filesystem.mjs web/web_audio_driver.mjs web/product_engine_worker_host.mjs web/product_engine_worker.mjs web/product_launcher.mjs
scripts.check:web:static: npm run check:web:syntax && npm run check:web:lint && npm run check:web:types
scripts.test:browser:product: set KISAK_WEB_SITE=build/web/site&& set KISAK_WEB_TEST_PORT=8018&& set KISAK_WEB_PRODUCT_TEST=1&& playwright test tests/browser/product.spec.mjs tests/browser/product_capabilities.spec.mjs tests/browser/product_filesystem_lease.spec.mjs tests/browser/product_input_scaling.spec.mjs tests/browser/product_mount_controller.spec.mjs
